card.name: Drug interaction section wording
card.fires_on: Scattered words inside drug-interaction passages, such as 'have' after 'tetracyclines', 'form' after 'Quinolones', or a digit in a number. The word sits right after a named drug or class and before the interaction effect.

modes.label: Verb after drug class
modes.description: A linking verb or small word right after a drug class or drug name that starts an interaction statement.
